subject: Archaeology
title: The Sanxingdui Bronze Masks
description: A quick win: understand The Sanxingdui Bronze Masks.

hook.text: In 1986, Chinese farmers found pits filled with gold masks and bronze faces unlike anything in Chinese history.

buildup.text: Sanxingdui held 3,000-year-old artifacts: a bronze tree 13 feet tall and masks with bulging eyes on stalks.

discovery.text: The site belongs to a civilization that mainstream Chinese history never mentioned. It was completely unknown.

twist.text: Everything was deliberately smashed, burned, and buried. Scholars think it was a ritual destruction or conquest.

climax.text: New pits discovered in 2020 contained gold masks and ivory, proving the site is far bigger than expected.

punchline.text: China's history books missed an entire civilization. The ground remembered.

quiz.question: What was unusual about the Sanxingdui artifacts when first discovered?
options: They were written in a script never seen before
They belonged to a civilization absent from Chinese historical records
They were made of materials not found anywhere in China
